notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.21.2. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `ownedRelatedElement += SatisfactionParameter` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. The production contributes no tokens of its own: it is the membership that carries the subject of a satisfaction, and everything visible is below it. The 'by' that introduces the subject belongs to SatisfyRequirementUsage, which is where the clause puts it (`( 'by' ownedRelationship += SatisfactionSubjectMember )?`), and the text of the subject itself is reached through SatisfactionParameter, a chain of four one-line productions ending at a FeatureChainMember.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.

Line 22 `satisfy vehicleSpecification by vehicle_design;` has the subject member after 'by': `vehicle_design`, reached through SatisfactionParameter's feature value and reference expression. Line 23 `satisfy engineSpecification by vehicle_design.engine_v1;` shows the same position taking a feature chain.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
